title: Thumb Pinball Pop
description: Play effortless one-thumb arcade pinball—ricochet balls off bouncy geometric shapes, snag extra-ball rings, and climb endless combo stages.
controls: Drag with one thumb to aim and release to bounce pinballs across target shapes and power rings.

zh-CN.title: 拇指弹球
zh-CN.description: 单手畅玩物理弹射拇指弹球：一根大拇指拉线发射弹球，精准弹射几何障碍收割星星轻松闯关！
zh-CN.controls: 单指按住拖动瞄准并松手发射，借助多次弹跳击碎图形砖块收集额外弹球。
